title: A workspace for photonic engineering
lead: AIFIELD brings design and simulation tasks into a photonic development workflow.
description: The September 2026 material describes CAD and solver work alongside experimental AI assistance. Neural field prediction is research, not a replacement for established solvers.

sections.title: Engineering workflow
paragraphs: Layer and process handling, mode, circuit, field and thermal simulation address different questions during design. Their precise current availability requires confirmation.

sections.title: Human-directed assistance
paragraphs: Command-line and Model Context Protocol explorations let an agent propose or run selected steps while a person reviews and applies the work. The material does not support autonomous end-to-end chip design.

sections.title: Evidence boundaries
paragraphs: Internal comparisons and a glucose chip-design example illustrate engineering activity. They do not demonstrate fabricated-chip performance or a validated glucose sensor.
